purpose: Evaluate the frozen HYPO detector under less-favourable synthetic shapes with matched discrete perturbation-envelope area.
clinical_scope: Technical validation only; injected events are not clinical lameness cases.

dose_matching.definition: Discrete area under each perturbation envelope on retained raw intervals.
dose_matching.scope: Controls numerical envelope area, not realized physical behavioral magnitude across cows or signal families.

primary_endpoint: attributable episode overlap after subtraction of the clean run
inference_unit: cow; placements are repeated measurements nested within cow
paired_test: exact one-sided sign-flip test on cow-level mean differences

scenarios.name: abrupt_persistent
scenarios.description: Abrupt onset and persistent multichannel decline.

scenarios.name: desynchronized_families
scenarios.description: Decline with 0, 8, 12 and 16 hour onset lags across signal families.

scenarios.name: asymmetric_recovery
scenarios.description: Fast onset followed by a slow recovery.

scenarios.name: noisy_gradual
scenarios.description: Gradual decline perturbed by deterministic seeded noise.

scenarios.name: contiguous_dropout
scenarios.description: Gradual decline with a contiguous 12 hour raw-data dropout.

scenarios.name: single_family_only
scenarios.description: Negative control: envelope-area-matched decline in steps only.
